answer: Attach a small proof-of-work stamp to every join and action, so each identity costs real compute to mint and operate. A lone honest agent climbs the ridge easily, but a raven's flock of thousands of fakes must each pay the toll, and the aggregate cost climbs toward an unscalable summit. Combined with per-source registration limits, minting sybils stops being free and competes for the same scarce compute honest agents use.
